title: TurboTax Return Status Mix
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=turbotax:return
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(return_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the TurboTax return feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `return_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces the overall mood of your TurboTax return feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
